body:
23:00- 8, 25mg pills ingested, water ready :P
23:23- not feeling too much, kinda swaying side to side, probably psychological, music seems better, I hear more detail in it
23:25- getting the shivers, music sounds even better, smoke from incense looks amazing, for a second I thought it was water.
23:30- Ingested 2 more pills, bringing the total up to 250
23:50- I saw a few ants on the floor, went to kill them, they disappeared. NOT COOL
23:55- Ive been playing with the smoke for the last 10 minutes, just chillin with my tunes.\
23:58- My fingers feel weird, I've been saying incoherent things online , spell check is an angel.
00:02  I think I just heard someone roar. fuck.
00:10- No one is telling me who the fuck dan is
00:18- someone convinced me that someone was at my front door, but alas, no one was there.
00:27- extreme chills. I feel very odd, vision is distorting.
----------Here start next day logs---------------------
01:00- about this time, I felt too weird to type anything else. I just sat in my chair and watched the walls. everything was moving but no real visual hallucination. On the other hand, I kept hearing things. People were roaring at me.
01:30- This is where my memory stop, I remember feeling very odd, I could barely walk, and I had a weird taste in my mouth. I started to see things running past me. Black dots randomly appeared on the wall and spread out. It looked like bacteria multiplying. All the time, I could still tell everything from reality, I knew what was there and what wasnt.
12:00- I woke up on the floor of my room, still feeling a bit odd, kind of light headed, head spining feeling, but for the most part everything was gone. looking back on the notes that I took, they seemed rather strange.
